children.text: Part 1: Inviting & Booking Cinema Tickets
children.cn: 第一部分：邀请与在线订票

children.text: Making Movie Invitations
children.cn: 提出看电影邀请

children.text: Hi, Peter! Are you free tomorrow?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 嗨，彼得！你明天有空吗？
children.notes: be free = 有空
children.statement: are you free... 用于询问对方是否有空。
children.explanation: be free 表示有空闲时间。

children.text: A new sci-fi film is coming out.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 一部新的科幻电影要上映了。
children.notes: come out = 上映，出版
children.statement: is coming out 在这里表示正在发生的事情，不能表示将来。
children.explanation: 现在进行时可用于表示按计划或安排即将发生的将来动作。

children.text: I know you like sci-fi films.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 我知道你喜欢科幻电影。
children.notes: sci-fi = science fiction 科幻
children.statement: sci-fi 是 science fiction 的缩写。
children.explanation: sci-fi 是科幻作品的常用简称。

children.text: Shall we go to see it?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 我们要一起去看吗？
children.notes: Shall we...? 用于提出建议
children.statement: Shall we 开头的句子常用于提议共同做某事。
children.explanation: Shall we do sth.? 是表示征求意见或提出建议的经典句型。

children.text: Oh, I'd love to!
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 哦，我很想去！
children.notes: I'd love to = I would love to，礼貌接受邀请
children.statement: I'd love to 是拒绝邀请的表达。
children.explanation: I'd love to 是“我很愿意去/做”的意思，表示接受邀请。

children.text: Choosing Cinema & Booking Tickets
children.cn: 选择影院与订票

children.text: Which cinema shall we go to?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 我们要去哪家影院？
children.notes: which cinema = 哪家影院
children.statement: which 用于在特定范围内进行选择。
children.explanation: which 表示“哪一个/哪一些”，用于有限选项的选择。

children.text: What about the Huaxia Cinema?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 华夏影城怎么样？
children.notes: What about...? = 建议做/考虑某事
children.statement: What about 后面可以接名词或动词 -ing 形式。
children.explanation: What about/How about... 介词后接名词、代词或动名词。

children.text: Good idea!
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 好主意！
children.notes: Good idea! = 赞同对方提议
children.statement: Good idea 用来赞同提案或建议。
children.explanation: Good idea 是极常用的口语赞同表达。

children.text: OK. I'll book the tickets online now ... OK, done.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 好的。我这就上网订票……好了，搞定。
children.notes: book tickets = 订票; online = 在线上
children.statement: book 在这里做名词，意思是“书本”。
children.explanation: book 在此处用作动词，意为“预订”。

children.text: The film starts at 5:15 p.m.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 电影下午5:15开始。
children.notes: at + 具体时间点
children.statement: 具体时间点前介词用 at。
children.explanation: 表示在具体几点钟用介词 at。

children.text: Good. Shall we meet at the cinema at five o'clock?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 太好了。我们五点在影院见可以吗？
children.notes: meet at... = 在……集合/见面
children.statement: Shall we meet 用于约定见面时间地点。
children.explanation: Shall we... 用于提出商量的建议。

children.text: All right. See you then!
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 好的。到时候见！
children.notes: See you then = 到时见
children.statement: See you then 意思是“现在见”。
children.explanation: then 指代约定好的那个未来时间，意为“到时见”。

children.text: Part 2: Discussing Predictions & Earth's Future
children.cn: 第二部分：讨论预测与地球未来

children.text: Movie Impressions & Climate Concerns
children.cn: 观影感受与气候担忧

children.text: What an exciting sci-fi film! I really loved the story.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 多么令人兴奋的科幻电影啊！我真的很喜欢这个故事。
children.notes: What an + adj. + n.! 感叹句
children.statement: What an 引导感叹句修饰单数可数名词。
children.explanation: What + a/an + 形容词 + 单数可数名词！是标准感叹句结构。

children.text: Me too. But do you think the film was right?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 我也是。但你觉得这部电影说得对吗？
children.notes: Me too = 我也是
children.statement: Me too 用来表达与前者相同的感受或情况。
children.explanation: Me too 是日常口语中表示同意前述肯定情况的表达。

children.text: Will climate change be worse in the future?
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 未来的气候变化会变得更糟糕吗？
children.notes: worse = bad 的比较级
children.statement: worse 是 bad 的最高级。
children.explanation: worse 是 bad 的比较级，最高级是 worst。

children.text: I'm afraid so. Some scientists believe there will be less land to grow food.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 恐怕是的。一些科学家认为种植粮食的土地将会变少。
children.notes: I'm afraid so = 恐怕是这样; less land = 更少的土地
children.statement: land 是不可数名词，所以用 less 修饰。
children.explanation: land（土地）不可数，用 little 的比较级 less 修饰。
children.keywords: afraid so, less land, grow food

children.text: Environmental Optimism & Space Exploration
children.cn: 环境乐观主义与太空探索

children.text: I don't think there will be less land.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 我不认为土地会变少。
children.notes: I don't think... 否定前置
children.statement: 英语中表达“我认为……不……”时，常把否定词放在主句动词 think 上。
children.explanation: 否定前置是英语中主观观点表达的语法习惯。

children.text: You seem quite positive about the future.
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 你对未来似乎挺乐观的。
children.notes: be positive about... = 对……态度积极/乐观
children.statement: positive 在这里表示“悲观的”。
children.explanation: positive 意为“积极的，乐观的”。

children.text: I am. I read that people could plant trees and turn deserts into forests.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 是的。我看过报道说人们可以种树，把沙漠变成森林。
children.notes: turn... into... = 把……变成……
children.statement: turn A into B 意思是把 A 变为 B。
children.explanation: turn... into... 是固定动词短语搭配。

children.text: And we can make more farmland too.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 而且我们还能开垦出更多农田。
children.notes: farmland = 农田
children.statement: farmland 是可数名词复数。
children.explanation: farmland 通常作为不可数名词使用。

children.text: Perhaps you are right. So, do you think we will still live on earth in the future?
children.speaker: Peter
children.cn: 也许你是对的。那么，你认为我们未来还会生活在地球上吗？
children.notes: live on earth = 生活在地球上
children.statement: live on earth 中 earth 前通常加定冠词 the，但在具体短语中省略或大写时有差异。
children.explanation: live on earth 表达生活在地球上。

children.text: Yes, but I believe we'll keep on exploring space.
children.speaker: Teng Fei
children.cn: 是的，但我相信我们会继续探索太空。
children.notes: keep on doing sth. = 持续/不断做某事
children.statement: keep on 后接动词原形。
children.explanation: keep on 是介词短语短语，后面必须跟随动名词 -ing 形式。

children.text: Part 1: Transport & City Life
children.cn: 第一部分：城市生活与交通变化

children.text: Greetings & Future Predictions Video
children.cn: 问候与未来预测视频

children.text: Hi, Jennifer. What's up?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 嗨，珍妮弗。近来怎样？
children.notes: What's up? = 近况如何？
children.statement: What's up? 是一种非正式的打招呼方式。
children.explanation: What's up? 是口语中常用的随意问候语。

children.text: Oh, hi, Helen. I'm watching a video about future predictions.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 哦，嗨，海伦。我正在看一段关于未来预测的视频。
children.notes: future predictions = 未来预测
children.statement: watching a video 是现在进行时表达。
children.explanation: be + V-ing 结构构成现在进行时。

children.text: So, what will the future be like?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 那么，未来会是什么样子？
children.notes: What will... be like? = ……将会是什么样？
children.statement: 句中的 like 是动词“喜欢”。
children.explanation: 在这里 like 是介词，意为“像……”。

children.text: Efficient Transport & Traffic Safety
children.cn: 高效交通与交通安全

children.text: Well, there will be more people in cities, but the transport system will be more efficient.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 嗯，城市里人口会更多，但交通系统效率会更高。
children.notes: efficient = 高效的; transport system = 交通系统
children.statement: there will be 后接名词表示“将来会有”。
children.explanation: there will be 是 there be 句型的一般将来时形式。

children.text: It means that there will be fewer traffic accidents.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 这意味着交通事故将会减少。
children.notes: fewer + 可数名词复数
children.statement: fewer 修饰不可数名词。
children.explanation: fewer 是 few 的比较级，专门用来修饰可数名词复数（如 accidents）。

children.text: Sounds great! Any other predictions?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 听起来棒极了！还有其他预测吗？
children.notes: Sounds + adj. = 听起来……
children.statement: Sounds 是系动词，后面接形容词做表语。
children.explanation: sound 是感官动词/系动词，后面跟形容词 great。

children.text: Part 2: Education & Health Care
children.cn: 第二部分：未来教育与医疗健康

children.text: Online Learning & Home Schooling
children.cn: 在线学习与居家教育

children.text: Students probably won't go to a school in the future.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 学生们在未来可能不会去学校了。
children.notes: won't = will not; probably = 很可能
children.statement: won't 是 will not 的缩写。
children.explanation: won't 等于 will not，表示一般将来时的否定。

children.text: They will study at home or any place they want.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 他们将在家里或任何想去的场所学习。
children.notes: any place they want = 任何他们想去的地方
children.statement: study 是系动词。
children.explanation: study 在这里是行为动词（实义动词）。

children.text: Oh, but I really like going to school! Anything else?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 哦，但我真的很喜欢去学校！还有别的吗？
children.notes: like doing sth. = 喜欢做某事
children.statement: Anything else 用于询问是否还有其他事物。
children.explanation: Anything else 是口语常用表达，询问“还有其他的吗”。
children.keywords: like going to school, anything else

children.text: Home Healthcare & Longer Lifespans
children.cn: 居家医疗技术与人均长寿

children.text: And people will live longer.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 而且人们会活得更长寿。
children.notes: longer = long 的比较级
children.statement: longer 在这里修饰动词 live，做副词的比较级。
children.explanation: longer 修饰动词 live，表示“更长久地（生存）”。

children.text: Really? Why?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 真的吗？为什么？
children.notes: Why = 询问原因
children.statement: Why 用来提问原因或理由。
children.explanation: Why 是询问原因的特殊疑问词。

children.text: Because we'll have better health care technology in our homes.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 因为我们家中会有更好的医疗保健技术。
children.notes: health care = 医疗保健
children.statement: Because 引导的句子用来回答 why 提出的问题。
children.explanation: Because 常用于回答 why 的提问，给出原因。

children.text: Machines will tell us how to solve small health problems before they become bigger.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 机器会在小健康问题变大之前告诉我们如何解决。
children.notes: how to solve = 如何解决; before = 在……之前
children.statement: before 引导的是时间状语从句。
children.explanation: before 连词引导表示时间的状语从句。

children.text: That'll be great. How long will most people live?
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 那太棒了。大多数人能活多久？
children.notes: How long = 多长时间/多久
children.statement: How long 在这里询问频率。
children.explanation: How long 在此处询问时间的长短或寿命的长度，而非频率（How often）。
children.keywords: that'll be great, how long, live

children.text: Well, more people will live to be over 100 years old.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 嗯，更多的人会活到100岁以上。
children.notes: over 100 years old = 超过100岁
children.statement: over 在这里相当于 more than，表示“超过”。
children.explanation: over 数字 表示超过该数量。

children.text: Some may even live to be 150.
children.speaker: Jennifer
children.cn: 有些人甚至可能活到150岁。
children.notes: may = 可能; even = 甚至
children.statement: may 是情态动词，后接动词原形。
children.explanation: 情态动词 may 后面跟动词原形 live。

children.text: Wow, that sounds wonderful!
children.speaker: Helen
children.cn: 哇，那听起来太棒了！
children.notes: sounds wonderful = 听起来极好
children.statement: wonderful 是副词修饰 sounds。
children.explanation: sound 是系动词，wonderful 是形容词充当表语。

children.text: Part 1: Introduction & Service Robots
children.cn: 第一部分：开场介绍与服务机器人

children.text: Show Opening & Guest Introduction
children.cn: 节目开场与嘉宾介绍

children.text: Good evening, everyone!
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 大家晚上好！
children.notes: Good evening = 晚上好
children.statement: Good evening 是傍晚或晚上的问候语。
children.explanation: Good evening 用于晚上见面时的问候。

children.text: Our guest today is Dr Lu Xingyuan, chief researcher of the Future World Research Centre.
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 我们今天的嘉宾是未来世界研究中心首席研究员陆兴远博士。
children.notes: chief researcher = 首席研究员
children.statement: chief 在这里是形容词，意为“首席的，主要的”。
children.explanation: chief 做前置定语，修饰 researcher。

children.text: So welcome to our show, Dr Lu.
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 欢迎来到我们的节目，陆博士。
children.notes: welcome to... = 欢迎来到……
children.statement: welcome to 后面接地点名词。
children.explanation: welcome to + 地点，表示欢迎来到某地。

children.text: Good evening. Thank you, it's a pleasure to be here.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 晚上好。谢谢你，很高兴能来到这里。
children.notes: It's a pleasure to do sth. = 很荣幸/高兴做某事
children.statement: It's a pleasure to... 是一句客套而礼貌的表达。
children.explanation: 这是标准的社交客套表达，意为“很高兴/荣幸能够做某事”。

children.text: Dr Lu, thank you for joining us.
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 陆博士，感谢您加入我们。
children.notes: thank you for doing sth. = 因做某事感谢某人
children.statement: for 是介词，后面跟动名词 joining。
children.explanation: 介词 for 后面需要使用动名词（V-ing）形式。

children.text: Robotics Industry & Household Tasks
children.cn: 机器人产业与家务劳动

children.text: So, as a futurist, can you tell us how life will be different in 50 years?
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 那么作为一名未来学家，您能告诉我们50年后生活会有什么不同吗？
children.notes: futurist = 未来学家; in 50 years = 50年之后
children.statement: “in + 时间段”常用于一般将来时，表示“在……时间之后”。
children.explanation: in + 时间段表示以现在为基准的将来某一段时间之后，配合将来时。

children.text: Well, you'll see robots working everywhere.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 嗯，你会看到机器人到处工作。
children.notes: see sb./sth. doing = 看到……正在做某事
children.statement: see robots working 表示看到机器人正在工作的状态。
children.explanation: see + 名词 + V-ing 表示看到某物/人正在进行某动作。

children.text: Can you give us some examples?
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 您能给我们举几个例子吗？
children.notes: give examples = 举例
children.statement: some 在疑问句中绝对不能使用。
children.explanation: 在希望得到肯定回答或表示请求、建议的疑问句中可以使用 some。

children.text: Well, as we all know, China's robotics industry is growing fast.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 嗯，众所周知，中国的机器人产业正在迅速发展。
children.notes: as we all know = 众所周知; robotics industry = 机器人产业
children.statement: as we all know 是固定插入语/从句。
children.explanation: as we all know 意为“众所周知”，常用于引入常识或共识。
children.keywords: as we all know, robotics industry, growing fast

children.text: Robots will make our life easier.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 机器人将使我们的生活更加轻松。
children.notes: make + n. + adj. = 使……处于某种状态
children.statement: easier 是 easy 的比较级。
children.explanation: easy 以辅音字母 + y 结尾，变比较级去 y 变 i 再加 er。

children.text: We'll have service robots.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 我们会有服务型机器人。
children.notes: service robots = 服务机器人
children.statement: service 在这里充当名词作定语修饰 robots。
children.explanation: 名词 service 修饰名词 robots，说明机器人的种类。

children.text: They will do almost all our housework.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 它们几乎会包揽我们所有的家务。
children.notes: do housework = 做家务
children.statement: housework 是可数名词。
children.explanation: housework 是不可数名词。

children.text: They will also help save lives when disasters and emergencies happen.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 当灾难和紧急情况发生时，它们还将有助于拯救生命。
children.notes: help (to) do sth. = 帮助做某事; emergencies = 紧急情况
children.statement: help 后面的动词不定式符号 to 可以省略。
children.explanation: help do sth. 中 to 常常省略直接加动词原形。

children.text: Part 2: Future Careers & Emotional Intelligence
children.cn: 第二部分：未来职业与情商优势

children.text: Disappearing Jobs & New Career Paths
children.cn: 消失的岗位与新兴职业

children.text: So, what jobs will humans still do in the future?
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 那么，人类在未来还会从事哪些工作呢？
children.notes: still = 依然，仍然
children.statement: humans 表示“人类”，其复数形式是 humans。
children.explanation: human 的复数形式直接加 s，为 humans。

children.text: Good question! Some jobs today will disappear in the coming years.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 问得好！今天的一些工作将在未来几年内消失。
children.notes: disappear = 消失（dis- 前缀表示否定）
children.statement: disappear 是及物动词，可以直接接宾语。
children.explanation: disappear 是不及物动词，后面不能直接加宾语。

children.text: However, there will be more challenging jobs in the future, such as space pilots and AI experts.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 然而，未来会有更多富有挑战性的工作，比如太空飞行员和人工智能专家。
children.notes: such as = 例如; challenging = 富有挑战性的
children.statement: such as 用来列举同类事物中的例子。
children.explanation: such as 用于举例，后接名词或代词。
children.keywords: challenging jobs, space pilots, AI experts

children.text: Human Creativity & Irreplaceability
children.cn: 人类创造力与不可替代性

children.text: Do you think robots will replace humans one day?
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 您认为有一天机器人会取代人类吗？
children.notes: replace = 取代，代替; one day = 有朝一日
children.statement: replace A with B 表示用 B 替换 A。
children.explanation: replace... with/by... 是固定搭配。

children.text: No, I don't.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 不，我不这么认为。
children.notes: 否定简短回答
children.statement: 这是对否定提问的回答。
children.explanation: 这是对前面“Do you think...?”这一一般疑问句的否定简答。

children.text: Our creativity and emotional intelligence are important for relationships.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 我们的创造力和情商对于人际关系至关重要。
children.notes: emotional intelligence = 情商; creativity = 创造力
children.statement: emotional 是名词修饰 intelligence。
children.explanation: emotional 是形容词，意为“情感的”，修饰名词 intelligence。

children.text: AI will not replace humans for these things.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 人工智能在这些方面是无法取代人类的。
children.notes: for these things = 在这些方面
children.statement: AI 是 Artificial Intelligence 的缩写。
children.explanation: AI 全称为 Artificial Intelligence（人工智能）。

children.text: Part 3: AI Impact & Future Preparation
children.cn: 第三部分：AI的影响与准备建议

children.text: AI Changing Daily Lifestyle
children.cn: AI改变生活方式

children.text: You mentioned AI. How will AI change our world?
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 您提到了人工智能。AI将如何改变我们的世界？
children.notes: mention = 提到，说起
children.statement: mentioned 是 mention 的过去式。
children.explanation: 规则动词 mention 的过去式直接在词尾加 -ed。

children.text: Well, it will certainly change how we work, study, and live.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 嗯，它无疑会改变我们工作、学习和生活的方式。
children.notes: certainly = 必定，无疑
children.statement: how 引导疑问词引导的从句充当 change 的宾语。
children.explanation: how we work, study, and live 是宾语从句。

children.text: For example, a smart refrigerator will know what you need and order food for you when you're running low.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 例如，一台智能冰箱会知道你需要什么，并在你的食物快用完时为你订购。
children.notes: smart refrigerator = 智能冰箱; run low = 即将用尽
children.statement: run low on sth. 表示“某物快用光了”。
children.explanation: run low (on sth.) 意为快要用尽/短缺。
children.keywords: smart refrigerator, order food, running low

children.text: Wow, that'll save us a lot of time!
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 哇，那会帮我们节省大量时间！
children.notes: save time = 节省时间
children.statement: a lot of 只可以修饰可数名词复数。
children.explanation: a lot of 既可以修饰可数名词复数，也可以修饰不可数名词（如 time）。

children.text: Practical Advice for the Future
children.cn: 迎接未来的实用建议

children.text: Now, my last question: How can we prepare for the future?
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 现在，我的最后一个问题：我们该如何为未来做好准备？
children.notes: prepare for... = 为……做准备
children.statement: prepare for 后接准备的对象或事件。
children.explanation: prepare for 是固定动词短语搭配。

children.text: It's simple. Just accept change.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 这很简单。拥抱变化即可。
children.notes: accept = 接受，接纳
children.statement: Just accept change 是一个祈使句。
children.explanation: 动词原形 accept 开头，省略主语，是祈使句。

children.text: Keep learning and working hard.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 保持学习，努力工作。
children.notes: keep doing sth. = 保持/坚持做某事
children.statement: keep 后面接动词时，必须使用动名词形式。
children.explanation: keep doing sth. 表示持续或反复做某事。

children.text: Today's choices will influence your future.
children.speaker: Dr Lu
children.cn: 今天的选择将决定你的未来。
children.notes: influence = 影响
children.statement: influence 在这里做名词。
children.explanation: influence 在此处充当谓语动词，意为“影响”。

children.text: Thank you for your time, Dr Lu.
children.speaker: Host
children.cn: 感谢您抽出宝贵时间，陆博士。
children.notes: Thank you for your time = 感谢您的时间
children.statement: 这是采访或谈话结束时常用的道谢语。
children.explanation: Thank you for your time 是非常标准和礼貌的致谢表达。

children.text: Introduction: The Fascination with Sci-Fi
Curiosity About the Future
Are you curious about the future?
children.cn: 你对未来感到好奇吗？
children.notes: be curious about = 对……感到好奇
children.statement: be curious about 表示对某事抱有好奇心。
children.explanation: curious 是形容词，意为“好奇的”，常与介词 about 搭配。

children.text: What do you think our life will be like in 50 years or more?
children.cn: 你认为在50年或更久之后，我们的生活会是什么样子的？
children.notes: What do you think... = 插入语；in 50 years = 50年之后（用于一般将来时）
children.statement: in 50 years 结构常用于一般将来时，表示“50年之后”。
children.explanation: in + 一段时间常用于一般将来时，表示“多久之后”。

children.text: To answer this, you can read a sci-fi book.
children.cn: 为了回答这个问题，你可以读一本科幻书。
children.notes: To answer this = 动词不定式作目的状语；sci-fi = 科幻（science fiction）
children.statement: To answer this 在句中作目的状语。
children.explanation: 动词不定式置于句首常作目的状语，表示“为了……”。

children.text: Perhaps you will have some ideas then.
children.cn: 也许到那时你就会有一些想法了。
children.notes: Perhaps = 也许，可能；then = 那时
children.statement: Perhaps 是副词，意为“也许，大概”。
children.explanation: perhaps 表示推测或可能性。

children.text: Today, many young readers are interested in science fiction.
children.cn: 如今，许多年轻读者对科幻小说很感兴趣。
children.notes: be interested in = 对……感兴趣
children.statement: be interested in 后面接名词或代词作介词宾语。
children.explanation: be interested in 是固定搭配，表示对某事感兴趣。
children.keywords: young readers, interested in, science fiction

children.text: But what makes it so popular?
children.cn: 但究竟是什么让它如此受欢迎呢？
children.notes: what makes it so popular = 特殊疑问句，make + 宾语 + 宾补
children.statement: popular 在句中作宾语补足语，修饰代词 it。
children.explanation: make + it (宾语) + so popular (形容词作宾补)。

children.text: Reason 1: Imagining Possibilities and Dreaming Big
Endless Imagination
For one thing, science fiction gives us a chance to imagine what our future will be like.
children.cn: 首先，科幻小说给了我们一个想象未来生活模样的机会。
children.notes: For one thing = 首先，一方面；a chance to do sth = 做某事的机会
children.statement: For one thing 意思是“首先/一方面”，常用于列举理由。
children.explanation: For one thing 是列举论据时的常用过渡短语。
children.keywords: For one thing, chance to imagine, future

children.text: Anything is possible.
children.cn: 一切皆有可能。
children.notes: Anything = 任何事物（不定代词作主语，谓语动词用单数）
children.statement: Anything 是复合不定代词，作主语时谓语动词用单数形式 is。
children.explanation: anything 是单数不定代词，系动词用 is。

children.text: We can dream big.
children.cn: 我们可以敢于梦想。
children.notes: dream big = 怀抱远大梦想
children.statement: dream big 意思是“做大梦/怀抱远大理想”。
children.explanation: dream big 是常用表达，鼓励人们敢于畅想未来。

children.text: Some people think there will be flying cars and robot servants.
children.cn: 有些人认为未来会有飞行汽车和机器人仆人。
children.notes: there will be = 将会有（there be句型的一般将来时）
children.statement: there will be 是 there be 句型的一般将来时结构。
children.explanation: there will be 表示将来存在某物。

children.text: Others believe we will learn more about strange aliens and other worlds.
children.cn: 另一些人相信我们会对奇异的外星人和其它世界了解更多。
children.notes: Some... Others... = 一些人……另一些人……；aliens = 外星人
children.statement: Some... Others... 是成对使用的常用结构，表示“有些人……有些人……”。
children.explanation: Some... Others... 用于对比不同的群体或观点。
children.keywords: Others believe, strange aliens, other worlds

children.text: Reason 2: Inspiring Future Inventions
Arthur C. Clarke and Space Stations
Another reason is that sci-fi writers and their work can inspire us to create the future.
children.cn: 另一个原因是科幻作家及其作品能够启发我们去创造未来。
children.notes: that引导表语从句；inspire sb to do sth = 激励某人做某事
children.statement: that 引导的是表语从句，在从句中不充当成分且不可省略。
children.explanation: Another reason is that... 中 that 引导表语从句。

children.text: In 1945, a sci-fi author named Arthur C. Clarke wrote about a system of space stations.
children.cn: 1945年，一位名叫阿瑟·C·克拉克的科幻作家写了一套空间站系统的设想。
children.notes: named Arthur C. Clarke = 过去分词短语作后置定语；space stations = 空间站
children.statement: 克拉克在1945年就提出了空间站系统的概念。
children.explanation: 文中明确说明 In 1945, Arthur C. Clarke wrote about a system of space stations。

children.text: In the article, he predicted the earth of the future would have many TV stations and people would send TV programmes around the world.
children.cn: 在文章中，他预言未来的地球将拥有许多电视台，人们将把电视节目发送到全世界。
children.notes: predicted = 预言；around the world = 全世界
children.statement: predicted 的宾语从句使用了过去将来时 would have 和 would send。
children.explanation: 主句是过去时 predicted，从句使用过去将来时 would + 动词原形。
children.keywords: predicted, TV stations, TV programmes around the world

children.text: However, this was before TV was a common item at home!
children.cn: 然而，这发生在电视成为家庭普通日常用品之前！
children.notes: common item = 常见物品/日常用品
children.statement: 克拉克做出这一预言时，电视已经在千家万户极为普及了。
children.explanation: 文中说 this was before TV was a common item at home（在电视普及之前）。

children.text: In a short story by Clarke, he suggested people in the future would use a system to talk with others around the world.
children.cn: 在克拉克的一篇短篇小说中，他提出未来的人们会使用一种系统与全世界的其他人交流。
children.notes: suggested = 提出/表明；talk with = 与……交谈
children.statement: 克拉克在短篇小说中描绘了全球通信系统的雏形。
children.explanation: 克拉克构想了通过系统与全球人们交流的设想。
children.keywords: short story, system to talk with others

children.text: Amazingly, the short story was actually the inspiration for the internet!
children.cn: 令人惊叹的是，这篇短篇小说居然就是互联网的灵感来源！
children.notes: Amazingly = 令人惊叹地；inspiration = 灵感来源
children.statement: inspiration 的意思是“灵感来源”。
children.explanation: inspiration 表示灵感或启发来源。

children.text: Reason 3 & Conclusion: New Perspectives on Our World
Understanding Real Life and Looking Ahead
Science fiction is also popular because it can make us think about our world in new ways.
children.cn: 科幻小说受欢迎还在于它能让我们以全新的方式思考我们的世界。
children.notes: because引导原因状语从句；in new ways = 以新的方式
children.statement: because 引导的是原因状语从句。
children.explanation: because 连接从句解释科幻小说受欢迎的第三个原因。
children.keywords: popular because, think about world, new ways

children.text: Although many sci-fi stories are set in imaginary worlds or societies, they can help us better understand the real world.
children.cn: 尽管许多科幻故事设定在虚构的世界或社会中，但它们能帮助我们更好地理解现实世界。
children.notes: Although引导让步状语从句；be set in = 以……为背景；imaginary = 想象的/虚构的
children.statement: Although 引导让步状语从句，主句中不能再用 but。
children.explanation: 英语中 Although 与 but 不能同时出现在同一个复合句中。
children.keywords: Although, imaginary worlds, understand real world

children.text: They can also make us excited when we feel like we are living in a boring world.
children.cn: 当我们觉得生活在一个无聊的世界时，它们也能让我们感到兴奋。
children.notes: make us excited = 使我们感到兴奋（形容词作宾补）；feel like = 感觉好像
children.statement: excited 意为“感到兴奋的”，常用来修饰人。
children.explanation: excited 表示人的主观感受“兴奋的”，exciting 意为“令人兴奋的”。
children.keywords: make us excited, feel like, boring world

children.text: What will the future be like?
children.cn: 未来会是什么样子呢？
children.notes: What will... be like? = 将会是什么样子？
children.statement: 这是一个询问未来状况的一般将来时特殊疑问句。
children.explanation: What will... be like 是询问未来特征的固定句式。

children.text: Sci-fi inspires us and helps us to understand what it could be like.
children.cn: 科幻小说启发了我们，并帮助我们理解未来可能会是什么模样。
children.notes: inspires = 启发；what it could be like = 宾语从句
children.statement: 科幻小说既能启发人们，也能帮助人们理解未来的可能性。
children.explanation: 文章总结点题：科幻小说激励并帮助我们认识未来。
children.keywords: inspires, helps understand, could be like
